name: Ben 10
tagline: It started with a watch that fell from the sky.
synopsis: Ten-year-old Ben Tennyson finds the prototype Omnitrix on a summer road trip with Grandpa Max and cousin Gwen. Ten aliens, one Rust Bucket, and a galaxy of trouble.

name: Ben 10: Alien Force
tagline: Five years later. The Omnitrix recalibrates.
synopsis: Fifteen-year-old Ben puts the Omnitrix back on to find Grandpa Max, uncovering the Highbreed invasion with Gwen and a reformed Kevin Levin. The recalibrated Omnitrix unlocks a new roster.

name: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien
tagline: Ben's secret is out — and now he can go Ultimate.
synopsis: Wearing the Ultimatrix, a world-famous sixteen-year-old Ben faces Aggregor, the Forever Knights, Vilgax and Dagon, evolving his aliens into their Ultimate forms.

name: Ben 10: Omniverse
tagline: A new Omnitrix, a new partner, and every alien ever.
synopsis: With the completed Omnitrix and Plumber partner Rook Blonko, Ben protects Undertown and Bellwood, while flashbacks revisit eleven-year-old Ben and the rise of Malware.
